editorialNotes.spellingDecision: The Atlas working form is 'Shishi-gashira'; unhyphenated 'Shishigashira' is retained as an institutional/search variant; RHS prose typo 'Shish geshira' is rejected.
editorialNotes.missingPrimaryHistory: No primary catalogue, registration record or original Japanese naming statement was recovered for cultivar origin or synonym priority.
